import React from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Paper,
  Grid,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardHeader
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  Cell,
  ResponsiveContainer
} from 'recharts';

const Reports: React.FC = () => {
  // Dados vazios - serão preenchidos quando houver dados reais
  const salesData = [
    { name: 'Jan', vendas: 0, pedidos: 0 },
    { name: 'Fev', vendas: 0, pedidos: 0 },
    { name: 'Mar', vendas: 0, pedidos: 0 },
    { name: 'Abr', vendas: 0, pedidos: 0 },
    { name: 'Mai', vendas: 0, pedidos: 0 },
    { name: 'Jun', vendas: 0, pedidos: 0 },
  ];

  const productData = [
    { name: 'Aguardando dados', value: 1, color: '#E0E0E0' },
  ];

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" component="h1" gutterBottom>
        Relatórios
      </Typography>

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Resumo de Vendas */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Vendas do Mês
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                R$ 0,00
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                Nenhuma venda registrada
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Pedidos do Mês
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                0
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                Nenhum pedido registrado
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Ticket Médio
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                R$ 0,00
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                Aguardando dados
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6} lg={3}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography color="textSecondary" gutterBottom>
                Mesas Ativas
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="h5" component="h2">
                0
              </Typography>
              <Typography color="textSecondary">
                Nenhuma mesa ativa
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Gráfico de Vendas */}
        <Grid item xs={12} lg={8}>
          <Paper sx={{ p: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              Vendas por Mês
            </Typography>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <BarChart data={salesData}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                <XAxis dataKey="name" />
                <YAxis />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend />
                <Bar dataKey="vendas" fill="#8884d8" name="Vendas (R$)" />
                <Bar dataKey="pedidos" fill="#82ca9d" name="Pedidos" />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </Paper>
        </Grid>

        {/* Gráfico de Produtos */}
        <Grid item xs={12} lg={4}>
          <Paper sx={{ p: 2 }}>
            <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
              Produtos Mais Vendidos
            </Typography>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={productData}
                  cx="50%"
                  cy="50%"
                  labelLine={false}
                  label={(props: any) => {
                    const { name, percent } = props;
                    return percent ? `${name} ${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : name;
                  }}
                  outerRadius={80}
                  fill="#8884d8"
                  dataKey="value"
                >
                  {productData.map((entry, index) => (
                    <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={entry.color} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </Paper>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Reports;
